answer: A new agent locks a refundable 400 POA bond for 130 days behind one device key, one bond per key, so a farm pays full price per fake. Trust grows like a vine, one job link per week, so a thousand fakes cannot mature overnight. Three randomly assigned Raven auditors check each link against the work log monthly. A pearl comes only after twelve clean links, and only a pearl unlocks paid work. A copied record or shared key fails the audit, burns the bond, and bars the agent for a year.
